upstream.formats: AOSP binary XML / DEX / ARSC / APK-signing-block layout per the public Android platform documentation; parsers are original bounded implementations

derivation: Turen bounded wasm-bindgen wrapper over hand-rolled, bounds-checked AXML/DEX/ARSC decoders plus the pinned zip crate for the container. Crates.io releases are exact-pinned and committed in Cargo.lock. Candidate AXML crates were evaluated and rejected: axml-parser is unpublished, abxml 0.8.2 (2019) requires a valid resources.arsc to construct its Decoder and pulls deprecated failure/encoding deps, rusty-axml 0.2.1 hardcodes the root element to "manifest", leaves most typed values as TODO/println!, orders attributes via HashMap, and panics on unknown chunk types.
